mutating.description: True if the task will alter the workspace or external systems.

publicSurface.description: True if exposing new endpoints, CLI commands, or APIs.

userFacing.description: True if end-users directly interact with the artifact output.

authOrSecrets.description: True if touching IAM, credentials, tokens, or permissions.

externalIntegration.description: True if invoking third-party services, APIs, or DBs.

assuranceLenses.description: Populated by the ModeResolver. Array of ModeIds.
